content.short: Keplr is a multi-chain wallet, originally built for Cosmos, now supporting EVM chains including Monad.
content.description: Keplr is a multichain wallet originating in the Cosmos ecosystem and now covering Monad and other networks. Users stake and liquid stake, swap across chains and manage all on-chain activity without switching wallets or networks. It ships as a browser extension and mobile app. The same stack is available open-source as an embedded wallet for other applications.
